svg.title: Grim reapers in the hyperbolic-plane product
svg.desc: Select vertical, parabolic or hyperbolic Killing motion in upper-half-plane × height coordinates. Profiles are schematics. A coordinate dilation is an intrinsic isometry, not Euclidean MCF scaling.
svg.text: Common spatial scale · teal: profile / slice · rust: second piece / asymptote · gray: reference geometry
